name: Enishi
source:
Birthplace: Hitachi Province
Sword: Mikazuki Munechika
Style: Yagyuu Shinkage-ryu

The official spy of Edo / Tokugawa Shogunate. He’s an expert in martial arts, but he has a irresponsible, happy-go-lucky personality. He won’t take any action if it’s not for something he’s interested in. It’s also impossible to stop his delusions, and he screws up from time to time.

[from [url=http://kokoronodamu.tumblr.com/post/36202686560/ken-ga-kimi-character-profiles/]kokoronodamu[/url]]
